notes: Tier shelf, four kinds kept (Safe k29, Fire-resistant safe k30, Gun safe k31, Cash box k32). Safe: installation types moved to t; 12 models covering Chubbsafes, Burg-Wächter, Phoenix, Securikey, Yale, SentrySafe plus Bob Vila test winners (SentrySafe SFW123GDC best overall, Paragon wall safe); Consul kept from old data; Chubbsafes Viper trimmed to meet the 12 cap. Fire-resistant safe: types document chest, fire file, media/data safe, fire bag; models from SentrySafe/Phoenix pages and Bob Vila heat-test winners (Honeywell 6104). Gun safe: 14-item Liberty-heavy list cut to 12 — Liberty Centurion/Colonial/Lincoln (Liberty's own top sellers) + HDV, Fort Knox Protector/Defender, Browning Yellowstone, Burg-Wächter Ranger N5/Magno, Brattonsound RL5+/SL9+, SentrySafe QAP1BLX pistol safe; dropped Eisenbach KWT 800, Rottner Gun 5 / HDW-5, Secureo SafeHero Hawk (SKU noise from a German comparison site; makers not market-covering), Liberty Freedom/Franklin/Presidential/USA/Fatboy (redundant tiers of one brand), and Browning Sporter / Phoenix Lacerta to fit the cap (brands still represented in register). Cash box kept as stub with one SentrySafe model. No Which?/Consumer Reports safe test could be retrieved (CR does not test safes; Which? not accessible), so Bob Vila tested reviews stand in as the independent test. Phoenix official site blocked (url_not_allowed), so retailer brand page used as source. Founding years left blank where not confirmed on a retrieved page. No craft traditions apply.
